_notes:
Panasonic AMG8833 (Grid-EYE) 8x8 infrared array sensor at 0x69 (AD_SELECT high, the usual board setting; 0x68 with it low isn't claimed, as MCP342x ADCs there take any byte written as their configuration). 8-bit registers
Detection: it has no ID register, so registers whose unused bits are 0 are checked: PCTL (0x00) one of its four modes (0x00 normal, 0x10 sleep, 0x20 and 0x21 stand-by), FPSC (0x02) only bit 0, INTC (0x03) only bits 1:0, and the thermistor's high byte (0x0F) only bits 3:0. Other chips at 0x68-0x69 (e.g. the MPU-6050 and DS3231 families) are tried first where they have a record with a stronger detection
Init: none - it starts in normal mode at 10 frames a second, with no interrupt and no moving average
Poll (100 ms): the thermistor (0x0E-0x0F) and the 64 pixels (0x80-0xFF). temperature is the 8x8 grid in degrees C: each pixel 12-bit two's complement, 0.25 C a count (the mask's top bit sign-extends it). ambient is the thermistor, 12-bit sign and magnitude (bit 11 the sign), 0.0625 C a count
Sample rate (_conf.rate): 10 or 1 frames a second (FPSC 0x02), with the poll interval
Source: registers and scaling from the Panasonic Grid-EYE (AMG88xx) datasheet

rsao.note: bench (Axiom018, 2026-10-26): the lone 0x99 moves the register pointer, and the read returns pixel data (0x99-0xA1); reading pixels changes nothing. PCTL, RST, FPSC, INTC, SCLR, AVE and the interrupt levels (0x00-0x0D) unchanged; frames carried on. Its address is in Axiom's excluded RSAO range anyway
